verdict.rationale: Reflect's own import/export docs say you can 'always export it into an open format (like HTML or Markdown)', and the reflect.app page describes local Markdown files with iCloud Drive or Git sync. Both support leaving with your notes in open formats. However, the export is a one-line mention: nothing shows it covers all data (attachments, images, backlinks, AI chats, history), and the API cannot serve note contents. The local-Markdown/open-source claims also sit oddly beside the cloud E2E-encrypted product description, which lowers confidence. Missing for 10: documented scope of a full-account export (attachments, backlinks, metadata), step-by-step export docs, independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete migration out.
